$comment: Model-facing output schema for POST /ai/plan-today. The model can only reference tasks by the opaque refs supplied in the request; the server drops any ref that was not supplied.

picks.description: Tasks proposed for today's list, in the suggested working order.

ref.description: The opaque ref of a task copied exactly from the input (e.g. 't7').

reason.description: Very short Korean reason for including this task today (e.g. '마감 내일', '어제 못 끝냄'). Based only on the provided fields.

summary.description: One or two short Korean sentences about the day's shape, mentioning today's meetings by name if provided. Empty string if nothing to add.
